reason: A DeepSeek Harness plugin that provides a versioned, tiered library of Hack The Box penetration-testing skill cards through a package-local skill provider; the README states it has no browser component or tools.

summaries.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供按领域和层级组织的 Hack The Box 渗透测试技能卡与参考内容。
summaries.en: Provides DeepSeek Harness with tiered Hack The Box penetration-testing skill cards and reference content organized by domain.

capabilities: Provides bundled Hack The Box penetration-testing instructional and reference skill cards
Registers a package-local skill provider for tiered skill discovery and loading
Supports hot reloading of edited package-local skills
